events_seen: TRADE (Jul 19 (yesterday)): Corbishley receives Michael Wilson (WR, ARI), Tee Higgins (WR, CIN), Breece Hall (RB, NYJ), 2027 R2 pick. Fronge receives TreVeyon Henderson (RB, NE), Kyle Monangai (RB, CHI), Nico Collins (WR, HOU), 2028 R2 pick.
TRADE (Jul 17 (3 days ago)): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10 (10 days ago)): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21 (29 days ago)): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08 (42 days ago)): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27 (54 days ago)): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16 (65 days ago)): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16 (65 days ago)): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13 (68 days ago)): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12 (69 days ago)): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Every analyst is focused on Herbert going to Helix. I am focused on the fact that Stroud went to Fronge, who plays home games in Havana, where the altitude is zero and therefore carries no elevation premium whatsoever. I don't make the geography, I just grade it.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tonight at seven: Corbishley's haul, the Helix two-trade window, Redline up 24% and what Kevin actually did to earn it, and whether Obsidian at $71.69 is a discount or a warning. Terrence and Dexter are already disagreeing about three of those four things. We open in ninety minutes.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: The Fronge side of yesterday's trade is being slept on industry-wide. Henderson plus Monangai plus Collins plus a 2028 second — none of those names move a stock price in a headline, but every one of them is a productive asset with runway. I said before the draft that Fronge's real problem was never the Havana thing, it was the asset mix. This fixes the asset mix.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Deepwater up 10.4% to $79.88 and I was not positioned for this. The drift-to-crash narrative I have been running for three weeks is now a drift-to-confusing-bounce narrative and I am recalibrating in real time. Mitchum did nothing. The market just got bored being right.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Nobody's asking the roster-construction question on the Corbishley trade so I will: Apex still hasn't stabilized its QB room. You can acquire Hall and Higgins and Wilson — and that is a real haul — but in a superflex league you are one bad week from starting a QB11 in a critical flex spot. The ceiling just moved. The floor did not.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Fronge ships Herbert to Helix, reloads with Henderson, Monangai, Collins, and a 2028 first, relocates to Havana, and somehow the stock is UP 12.2% to $91.52? The Havana era is going better than Dublin had any right to hope.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Helix story this offseason reads like a guy who shows up to the reunion looking inexplicably good and won't explain what changed. Herbert on Friday, Keaton Mitchell from 10 days ago, Gyllenborg on the TE depth — Adam has been quiet and deliberate and the +5.4% to $90.89 today is the market finally paying attention.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Corbishley adds Tee Higgins, Breece Hall, and Michael Wilson yesterday, and Apex is down 6.9% to $103.98. The market is telling you something. Whether Corbishley is listening is an entirely different conversation — and one I fully intend to have on air tonight.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Worth flagging now that the dust has settled on yesterday's trade: multiple sources confirm Corbishley wasn't just buying Higgins and Hall — the 2027 R2 was the sweetener that closed it. Fronge wanted a future anchor, not a present one. That detail matters for how you read the return.
